check_simplified_script.prediction_semantics: flag if OpenCC t2s changes candidate text (Traditional characters present)

check_traditional_script.prediction_semantics: flag if OpenCC s2t changes candidate text (Simplified-form characters present)

notes: The two checks have opposite target-script semantics and are reported separately.
The four en-te mixed_script rows are Telugu and are excluded from Chinese script accuracy.
mixed_script in en-yue means Traditional Chinese mixed with Latin words; it is not a Simplified-vs-Traditional mixed-character label.

en->zh.method: CJK characters / English words for EN->ZH/YUE; English words / CJK characters for ZH/YUE->EN
en->zh.threshold_rationale: Operational bounds widened from Andromeda reference-pair P05/P95 tails; first-pass anomaly screening only.

en->yue.method: CJK characters / English words for EN->ZH/YUE; English words / CJK characters for ZH/YUE->EN
en->yue.threshold_rationale: Operational bounds widened from Andromeda reference-pair P05/P95 tails; first-pass anomaly screening only.

zh->en.method: CJK characters / English words for EN->ZH/YUE; English words / CJK characters for ZH/YUE->EN
zh->en.threshold_rationale: Operational bounds widened from Andromeda reference-pair P05/P95 tails; first-pass anomaly screening only.

yue->en.method: CJK characters / English words for EN->ZH/YUE; English words / CJK characters for ZH/YUE->EN
yue->en.threshold_rationale: Operational bounds widened from Andromeda reference-pair P05/P95 tails; first-pass anomaly screening only.

length_ratio_method: EN->ZH/YUE: CJK output characters divided by English source words; ZH/YUE->EN: English output words divided by CJK source characters.
threshold_rationale: The 0.70-2.60 EN->ZH, 0.70-2.80 EN->YUE, and 0.35-1.45 reverse bounds are conservative operational guardrails widened from the Andromeda reference-pair P05/P95 tails. Minimum source-unit cutoffs use the lower-tail source length. These are first-pass anomaly screens, not semantic adequacy metrics; review false positives and recalibrate on larger production samples.
